Like a sea of grass, the savannah, prairie and meadows are among the most productive habitats on Earth, housing some of the greatest concentrations of big game and dramatic interactions between predator and prey.
Different animals use the terrain and their unique attributes to their advantage and defeat their opponents at each location, becoming masters of communication, camouflage, diplomacy, and combat.
Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark.
